award.description: The com.professorbutts.sports.award record. The CID pins the version the fan accepted; readers use the current version for status.

pinned.description: Show among the fan's featured badges.

main.description: Recommended key: the award's rkey, so a fan has one badge per award.

description: A fan's choice to show an award on their profile. Lives in the fan's own repo and points at the award in the issuer's repo. Readers verify it: the award must exist in the contest publisher's repo, its subject must be this repo's DID, and it must not be revoked. Copying a badge to another repo fails that check.
